Done. The product page now renders the title immediately while the live inventory streams in. **What was wrong:** `app/product/page.tsx` was a single async server component that `await getInventory()` before returning any HTML. Since `getInventory()` calls `connection()` (opting into dynamic rendering), the entire response — including the static `

Premium Widget

` — was blocked until the inventory resolved. **The fix:** Split the page so the static title renders immediately and only the dynamic inventory is awaited inside a `Suspense` boundary: - `

Premium Widget

` now renders synchronously and streams first. - A new `Inventory` async component does the `await getInventory()`. - It's wrapped in `Loading inventory…

}>`, so Next.js streams the title immediately and fills in the stock/price once the inventory resolves. Verified: `tsc --noEmit` passes (exit 0). The data layer (`lib/data.ts`) was left unchanged since it correctly opts into dynamic rendering.
